## Your plan does not say what its steps are for

You ended your turn with `STATUS: DONE`, but steps of `.agent/plan.md` name no requirement of your item, or name one
that it does not have. Every step that is not given up carries one line `For:` with the numbers of the requirements it
serves, for example `For: R1, K2`.

- Steps with no `For:` line: 1.2
- Steps that name a requirement your item does not have: none
- The requirements of your item: R1, R2, K1

Add or correct the `For:` line of each of those steps, and give a step up (`[-]`) with its reason when it serves no
requirement. Then end your turn as before.
